name: HHHCORP
recent: 公司近期出现董事与大股东股权变动，包括Datin Chow Pui Ling与Dato' Chan Say Hwa在公开市场增持股份。此外，公司于8月发布季度业绩，并更换公司秘书及注册地址。
notable: Datin Chow Pui Ling and Dato' Chan Say Hwa acquired a total of 9,837,000 shares (2.49%) at RM0.140 per share on 1 Oct 2024.。
The company changed its registered address.。
The company changed its company secretary to Thien Lee Mee.。

recent_en: The company recently saw changes in director and substantial shareholder interests, including on-market acquisitions by Datin Chow Pui Ling and Dato' Chan Say Hwa. It also released quarterly results in August and changed its company secretary and registered address.
notable_en: Datin Chow Pui Ling and Dato' Chan Say Hwa acquired a total of 9,837,000 shares (2.49%) at RM0.140 per share on 1 Oct 2024.
The company changed its registered address.
